name: Lord of the Fruitable
body:
And it towered over the fields, lord of all which grew and prospered. The great aplocopenoberrynanacadokin.

Prerequisite(s): Fruitable.

Benefits: The fruitable chooses three fruitable subspecies they do not already possess, gaining their subspecies abilities. The fruitable may use their inconspicuous ability to disguise and hide as a fruit of any of their subspecies.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time a fruitable takes this feat, the fruitable selects three other fruitable subspecies.

Special: This feat may be taken in place of a number of class features, such as alchemist discoveries, fighter combat feats, rogue talents, sorcerer bloodline feats, subject to GM discretion.
